Edge.content: def Edge (V : Type u) := V → V → Prop

Path.content:
inductive Path (E : Edge V) : V → V → Prop
| nil  : ∀ v, Path E v v
| step : ∀ {u v w}, Path E u v → E v w → Path E u w

Path.nil.content: | nil  : ∀ v, Path E v v

Path.step.content: | step : ∀ {u v w}, Path E u v → E v w → Path E u w

refl.content: theorem refl (v : V) : Path (E:=E) v v := Path.nil v

trans.content:
theorem trans {u v w : V} : Path (E:=E) u v → Path (E:=E) v w → Path (E:=E) u w :=
by
  intro p1 p2; induction p2 with
  | nil => simpa using p1
  | step p2' evw ih => exact Path.step ih evw

Erev.content: def Erev (E : Edge V) : Edge V := fun x y => E y x

undirected.content: def undirected (E : Edge V) : Prop := ∀ x y, E x y → E y x

reverse_path.content:
theorem reverse_path {u v : V} (hE : undirected E) :
  Path (E:=E) u v → Path (E:=E) v u :=
by
  intro p; induction p with
  | nil => exact Path.nil _
  | step p' evw ih =>
      -- reverse step: u →* v and edge v→w implies w →* u
      have hwv : Path (E:=E) _ _ := Path.step (E:=E) (Path.nil _) (hE _ _ evw)
      exact trans (E:=E) hwv ih

concat_edge_right.content:
theorem concat_edge_right {u v w : V} :
  Path (E:=E) u v → E v w → Path (E:=E) u w :=
by intro p evw; exact Path.step p evw

concat.content:
theorem concat {u v w : V} :
  Path (E:=E) u v → Path (E:=E) v w → Path (E:=E) u w :=
by intro p q; exact trans p q

edge_path.content:
theorem edge_path {u v : V} : E u v → Path (E:=E) u v :=
by intro euv; exact Path.step (Path.nil u) euv

concat_edge_left.content:
theorem concat_edge_left {u v w : V} :
  E u v → Path (E:=E) v w → Path (E:=E) u w :=
by intro euv pvw; exact trans (edge_path (E:=E) euv) pvw

concat3.content:
theorem concat3 {u v w t : V} :
  Path (E:=E) u v → Path (E:=E) v w → Path (E:=E) w t → Path (E:=E) u t :=
by intro puv pvw pwt; exact trans (trans puv pvw) pwt

reverse_in_Erev.content:
theorem reverse_in_Erev {u v : V} :
  Path (E:=E) u v → Path (E:=Erev E) v u :=
by
  intro p; induction p with
  | nil => exact Path.nil _
  | step p' evw ih =>
      -- in Erev, an E-edge v→w becomes edge w→v
      have hwv : Path (E:=Erev E) _ _ := Path.step (Path.nil _) evw
      exact trans hwv ih

cycle_refl.content:
theorem cycle_refl {v w : V} :
  Path (E:=E) v w → Path (E:=E) w v → Path (E:=E) v v :=
by intro pvw pwv; exact trans pvw pwv

Path.content:
Inductive Path (E : Edge) : V -> V -> Prop :=
  | Pnil  : forall v, Path E v v
  | Pstep : forall u v w, Path E u v -> E v w -> Path E u w.

Pnil.content: | Pnil  : forall v, Path E v v

Pstep.content: | Pstep : forall u v w, Path E u v -> E v w -> Path E u w.

path_refl.content:
Lemma path_refl (E : Edge) (v : V) : Path E v v.
  Proof. apply Pnil. Qed.

append_right.content:
Fixpoint append_right (E : Edge) (v w : V) (p2 : Path E v w)
           {struct p2} : forall u : V, Path E u v -> Path E u w :=
    match p2 with
    | @Pnil _ v0 => fun _ p1 => p1
    | @Pstep _ v0 y z pv Eyz => fun u p1 => Pstep E u y z (append_right E v0 y pv u p1) Eyz
    end.

trans.content:
Lemma trans (E : Edge) (u v w : V) :
    Path E u v -> Path E v w -> Path E u w.
  Proof. intros p1 p2; exact (append_right E v w p2 u p1). Qed.

undirected.content: Definition undirected (E : Edge) : Prop := forall x y, E x y -> E y x.

concat_edge_right.content:
Lemma concat_edge_right (E : Edge) (u v w : V) :
    Path E u v -> E v w -> Path E u w.
  Proof. intros p evw; now apply (Pstep _ _ _ _ p evw). Qed.

concat.content:
Lemma concat (E : Edge) (u v w : V) :
    Path E u v -> Path E v w -> Path E u w.
  Proof. intros; eapply trans; eauto. Qed.

edge_path.content:
Lemma edge_path (E : Edge) (u v : V) : E u v -> Path E u v.
  Proof.
    intro euv.
    refine (Pstep E u u v _ euv).
    apply Pnil.
  Qed.

concat_edge_left.content:
Lemma concat_edge_left (E : Edge) (u v w : V) :
    E u v -> Path E v w -> Path E u w.
  Proof.
    intros euv pvw.
    eapply trans; [apply edge_path; exact euv|exact pvw].
  Qed.

concat3.content:
Lemma concat3 (E : Edge) (u v w t : V) :
    Path E u v -> Path E v w -> Path E w t -> Path E u t.
  Proof.
    intros puv pvw pwt.
    eapply trans; [eapply trans; eauto|assumption].
  Qed.

Erev.content: Definition Erev (E : Edge) : Edge := fun x y => E y x.

reverse_in_Erev.content:
Lemma reverse_in_Erev (E : Edge) (u v : V) :
    Path E u v -> Path (Erev E) v u.
  Proof.
    intro p; induction p.
    - apply Pnil.
    - eapply trans; [|apply IHp].
      eapply Pstep; [apply Pnil|assumption].
  Qed.

cycle_refl.content:
Lemma cycle_refl (E : Edge) (v w : V) :
    Path E v w -> Path E w v -> Path E v v.
  Proof. intros pvw pwv; eapply trans; eauto. Qed.
